verdict.rationale: Airbyte publishes a documented public REST API for programmatic control (with access-token auth), plus a Terraform provider and PyAirbyte SDK for driving the platform programmatically, explicitly mentioning orchestration/automation use cases like Airflow — directly serving AI-native/agentic workflows alongside its MCP server for agent connectivity. missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI spec at standard endpoints (probe returned 404s) and no independent third-party corroboration of API robustness/versioning.
